The functions $f(x)$ and $g(x)$ are differentiable on an open interval containing $x=2.$ The values of $f,$ $g,$ and their respective derivatives are shown in the following table:

| $x$ | $f(x)$ | ${f}^{′}(x)$ | $g(x)$ | ${g}^{′}(x)$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $2$ | $1$ | $3$ | $3$ | $4$ |

Using the values from the table, evaluate the following limit:

${lim}_{x\to 2}\frac{\sqrt{x+g(x)}-\sqrt{5}}{f(x)+x-3}=$
{{field-1}}
